description: Per-(search_query x seller) impressions / clicks / spend / CTR for a marketplace over a period, plus an auto-vs-manual match-type impression split, from os_ads_search_query_performance_report (PLA search-query data). Grouped by search_query and seller (seller_id + merchant_name, with os_client_id). Dates are bucketed in the agency's local timezone via the __SP_TIMEZONE__ system placeholder. Filter by search_query, seller_id, or os_client_id to scope the breakdown.

search_query.description: The search term the shopper typed that this ad served against.

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id of the advertiser (working id for internal analysis).

seller_id.description: Seller (merchant) id (working id for internal analysis).

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions for this search_query x seller pair.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Ad clicks for this search_query x seller pair.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend for this search_query x seller pair, in the currency stored on the search-query report (p.cost).

ctr.selector: COALESCE(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.clicks ELSE 0 END) * 100.0, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)), 0)
ctr.description: Click-through rate (%) = clicks / impressions * 100 for this search_query x seller pair.

auto_impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND p.keyword_match_type = 'AUTO' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
auto_impressions.description: Impressions served via AUTO (auto-targeted) match type for this search_query x seller pair.

manual_impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND p.keyword_match_type != 'AUTO' THEN p.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
manual_impressions.description: Impressions served via non-AUTO (manual / broad / phrase / exact) match types for this search_query x seller pair.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_search_query_performance_report` AS p JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS cl ON cl.client_id = p.client_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON p.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(p.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
